sources.label: SWE-Bench Lite
sources.notes: Iteration and sanity-check probe; not the formal A8 gate.

sources.label: SWE-Bench Verified
sources.notes: Formal A8 gate: resolve_rate >= 0.8, which is 400/500 on the local test dataset.

sources.label: SWE-bench Live Verified
sources.notes: Leaderboard-track live issue-resolving dataset. The autonomous harness packages preds.json/results.json/README.md for the official submission PR flow.

sources.label: SWE-bench Live Evaluator
sources.notes: Official SWE-bench Live evaluator repository used by the autonomous harness official_harness phase.

sources.label: SWE-Bench Full
sources.notes: Comprehensive SWE-Bench test split for broader regression tracking.

sources.label: Codeforces / CodeContests
sources.notes: The A8 gate is rating-equivalent >= 3000. CodeContests is connected as public competitive-programming data, but full raw download is large.

sources.label: MLE-Bench
sources.notes: Benchmark code is public. Raw competition data requires Kaggle credentials and per-competition downloads.

sources.label: RE-Bench
sources.notes: Public METR task suite. Some protected files require the official extraction step.

sources.label: SWE-ReBench
sources.notes: Curated public SWE-ReBench leaderboard task set from Nebius. The A8 gate remains resolve_rate >= 0.6.

sources.label: Sustained Coding Window
sources.notes: Internal evidence gate: >= 100 tasks across >= 3 windows.

sources.label: Recursive Compounding
sources.notes: Internal evidence gate: >= 5 retained-gain runs across >= 3 windows.
